name: Morris water maze
description: The animal swims in a circular pool of opaque water and learns to locate a submerged escape platform using distal cues around the room. Assesses spatial learning and memory.

parameters.label: Pool diameter
parameters.help: Internal diameter of the pool at the water surface, measured wall to wall.

parameters.label: Platform diameter
parameters.help: Diameter of the top surface of the escape platform.

parameters.label: Platform x offset
parameters.help: Horizontal offset of the platform center from the pool center, as seen in the camera image. Positive to the right, negative to the left.

parameters.label: Platform y offset
parameters.help: Vertical offset of the platform center from the pool center, as seen in the camera image. Positive toward the top, negative toward the bottom.

parameters.label: Wall annulus width
parameters.help: Width of the outer ring along the pool wall. Time spent in this ring is scored as thigmotaxis (wall hugging).

parameters.label: Minimum platform dwell time
parameters.help: The animal must remain on the platform for at least this long for the trial to count as an escape; brief contacts are ignored.

parameters.label: Maximum tracking gap
parameters.help: Longest tracking dropout that is bridged; movement across a longer gap is excluded. Increase only for low-frame-rate videos.

zones.label: Platform
zones.geometry: Closed disk of diameter platform_diameter_cm centered on the platform position.

zones.label: Target quadrant
zones.geometry: Pool quadrant that contains the platform center (x >= 0 is east, y >= 0 is north).

zones.label: Wall annulus
zones.geometry: Outer ring of the pool: points at a distance >= pool radius - wall_annulus_width_cm from the pool center.

events.label: Platform visit
events.definition: Run of contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample lies in the platform.

events.label: Platform entry
events.definition: Time of the later sample of a counted interval that enters the platform.

metrics.label: Tracked duration
metrics.description: Total time during which the animal was tracked.
metrics.definition: Coordinates are in centimeters relative to the pool center, with x pointing east and y north; samples outside the pool are treated as lost. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples separated by 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Escape latency
metrics.description: Time taken to reach the platform; latencies that decrease across trials indicate learning.
metrics.definition: Onset of the first platform dwell: a run of consecutive tracked samples on the platform, with no gap longer than max_sample_gap_s, that lasts at least min_platform_dwell_s.
metrics.formula: first dwell start with last - first sample time >= min_platform_dwell_s
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when no dwell meets the criterion, as in probe trials.

metrics.label: Path length
metrics.description: Distance swum before reaching the platform; shorter paths indicate a more direct search.
metrics.definition: Distance traveled over counted intervals that end at or before the escape, or over the whole trial if there is no escape.
metrics.formula: sum(hypot(dx, dy) for counted intervals ending <= escape)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Mean swim speed
metrics.description: Path length divided by swim time; helps rule out motor impairment as a confound.
metrics.definition: Path length divided by the counted time it covers.
metrics.formula: path_length_cm / counted time up to escape
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when no counted time precedes the escape.

metrics.label: Time in target quadrant
metrics.description: Fraction of time spent in the target quadrant; in a probe trial, higher values indicate better memory of the platform location.
metrics.definition: Fraction of the tracked duration in counted intervals whose earlier sample lies in the target quadrant.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Thigmotaxis
metrics.description: Fraction of time spent swimming close to the wall; high values suggest anxiety-like behavior or a poor search strategy.
metrics.definition: Fraction of the tracked duration in counted intervals whose earlier sample lies in the wall annulus.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Platform crossings
metrics.description: Number of times the animal crossed the platform location; in a probe trial, more crossings indicate better spatial memory.
metrics.definition: Number of counted intervals that enter the platform disk; starting the trial on the platform is not a crossing.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Mean distance to platform
metrics.description: Average distance from the platform location; smaller values indicate a more focused search.
metrics.definition: Time-weighted mean distance from the platform center, using the earlier sample of each counted interval.
metrics.formula: sum(distance(earlier sample, platform) x dt) / sum(dt)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.
